title: EU Forces Every Chatbot to Admit It's AI Starting Now
summary:
The EU began enforcing Article 50 of the AI Act on 2 August 2026, requiring chatbots and AI systems to disclose they are AI, deepfakes to be clearly labeled, and AI-generated content to carry machine-readable marks. Non-compliance risks fines up to €15 million or 3% of global turnover.

In this episode of Front Page, we break down the four areas covered by the Commission's new guidelines, the transparency code of practice signed by 180-plus organizations, the AI office's new reporting channels, and what this first broad enforcement phase means for GPAI providers.

summary: In episode 1013 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Dr. Cathy O'Neil, NY Times Bestselling Author about whether AI is held to a higher standard than humans.
